text:
sarah.ng: FYI escalating — multiple tenants reporting spikes of 502/504s to Hosted API when sending large batched payloads (embeddings + generate). Started ~2026-03-16T08:12Z. Customer trace ids: trace:abc123 def456. Happening across regions (us-east, eu-west). Repro attached below, asking SRE for quick triage.

david.ops: Looking at edge metrics now — h2 stream utilization ~98% on the ingress pool, upstream error rate spiked at the same time window. Envoy shows a lot of upstream resets and stream window errors.

ingress-bot: [alert] ingress.edge.requests.error_rate > 3% for hosted-api-prod (08:10-08:20 UTC) — firing to #support and #eng-sre.

kevin.m: Any recent deploys or keystore rotations? High connection churn + a small auth cache could cause auth proxy to throttle and then starve pools.

support-jen: Customer repro: single request with 2 attachments (base64) + prompt ~120k bytes. They also said embedding batch of 50 vectors triggers it. Asking them for a curl reproduction.

sarah.ng: here's a quick curl the customer provided (sanitized):

```
curl -v "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"xlarge-v1","input":"<very large payload>","attachments":[{"name":"img","data":"<base64>"}]}'
```

Response seen: 502 from gateway, no body, occasionally 504 when waiting for upstream. Trace id in header: x-rw-trace: abc123.

david.ops: Poking logs: sample Envoy snippets show upstream connection resets and stream level window errors — suspects h2 concurrency + long-lived streams cause connection window exhaustion.

```
[2026-03-16T08:12:03.456Z] envoy upstream reset: reason=connection_failure, upstream_host=10.12.7.44:443, trace=abc123
[2026-03-16T08:12:04.002Z] http2: stream 0: WINDOW_UPDATE size overflow
[2026-03-16T08:12:05.111Z] upstream response timeout after 10s
```

kevin.m: Two-pronged likely: (1) large payloads keep streams open and exhaust `max_concurrent_streams` or connection windows, (2) auth keystore rotation earlier today evicted some cache entries and caused auth backend fanout, increasing upstream latency.

support-jen: Customer confirmed they sent with HTTP/2 multiplexing enabled (client side) and saw failures only when batching several requests concurrently.

david.ops: Short mitigations we can try now:
- increase envoy upstream timeout for the affected route to 30s
- temporarily increase connection pool size / max concurrent streams on ingress (canary)
- enable ingress-level request body buffering for these routes to prevent long-lived streams
- add a retry for 502 on idempotent embedding calls (with small backoff)

kevin.m: I'm rolling a canary to bump `envoy.max_concurrent_streams` and `ingress.socket_timeout` on the canary cluster. Monitoring pools. Also rolling back minor keystore TTL change on canary to see auth cache behavior.

sarah.ng: Noted, please confirm if we should instruct customers to chunk payloads or use streaming endpoints as workaround. Also label as P1 for support SLA.

support-jen: Sent customer suggested repro changes: chunk embeddings into batches of 10, switch to streaming for large attachments. They can also set `Connection: close` as a temporary workaround to avoid multiplexing.

david.ops: Canary shows reduced reset rate after bumping concurrent streams on canary (08:18). Ingress pool usage dropped from 98% -> 70% on canary. Rolling to 10% of traffic now.

kevin.m: If rolling to prod, we should also add a circuit-breaker tweak: reduce max pending requests per upstream to avoid head-of-line stalls, and tune transmit window sizes for h2. I'll prepare a PR.

sarah.ng: Thanks team. Action items:
- kevin.m: PR for circuit-breaker + keystore TTL rollback (in progress)
- david.ops: roll configuration to prod with gradual ramp if metrics stay good
- support-jen: confirm workarounds with customer and collect exact failing payload if they can share sanitized sample

ingress-bot: [resolve] alert suppressed for canary cluster at 08:22 UTC; global alert still firing at low rate, monitoring.

sarah.ng: Marking this thread for follow-up post-mitigation, include latency and error rate deltas and customer impact summary. If anyone sees another spike re-open.

kevin.m: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ingress/+/r/1234 — includes h2 window and cb tuning + rollback flag. Will watch after merge.

support-jen: Customer confirmed retries + chunking removed failures for them during testing. They'll reach out if they hit again.

ingress-bot: [monitor] next report in 15m; keeping watch.

sarah.ng: closing on our side for now — low level of errors remain but customer-level impact resolved. Will file postmortem if we see recurrence.
